ev.q: The percentage of aides who were completely vaccinated was lower among those working in facilities
The proportion of persons who declined COVID-19 vaccination ranged from 11.1% among physicians to 33.2% among aides.
During March 2021, 300 LTCFs reported COVID-19 vaccination coverage for their HCP.
Vaccination coverage was highest among physicians and advanced practice providers (75.1%)
Higher vulnerability tertile: zip code areas with household median income ≤$48,770
CDC analyzed data submitted during March 1–April 4, 2021, to describe COVID-19 vaccination coverage among a convenience sample
LTCFs voluntarily reported HCP COVID-19 vaccination data using the NHSN COVID-19 vaccination modules

methods_quotes.q: confidence intervals were not calculated, nor was statistical testing for percentages performed
Tertiles (higher, moderate, and low) were calculated for each indicator based on the national distribution of zip code areas
Facilities were included for analysis only if they had reported nonzero values for the number of HCP
